info.name: OxideAuth
info.description:
Postman collection for the OxideAuth IAM API.

All endpoints return a standard JSON envelope:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "data": { ... }
}
```

## Quick Start
1. Set the `host` variable to your API base URL (default: http://127.0.0.1:8000)
2. Set the `owner_email` and `owner_password` variables to your bootstrap credentials
3. Run the **Auth > Login** request and copy the returned `token` into the `token` variable
4. Set a valid `workspace_id` to use across entity endpoints
5. Set a valid `workspace_id` — a collection pre-request script automatically injects the `X-Workspace-Id` header on entity requests (see Automatic Header Injection below)

## Workspace Scoping

OxideAuth supports two token scopes:

- **Workspace-scoped tokens** are bound to a single workspace. Requests operate on that workspace automatically; the `X-Workspace-Id` header is ignored.
- **Global-scope tokens** are not bound to any workspace. To target a workspace, send the `X-Workspace-Id` header with the workspace id on every entity request.

Entity requests (clients, accounts, projects, roles, permissions, memberships, credentials) include a pre-defined `X-Workspace-Id` header:

```
X-Workspace-Id: {{workspace_id}}
```

The header is **disabled by default** so requests work out of the box with workspace-scoped tokens. When using a global-scope token, set the `workspace_id` variable — the pre-request script injects the header automatically (see Automatic Header Injection below). It is ignored for workspace-scoped tokens.

Workspace endpoints (Create/Describe/List/Update/Delete Workspace) do **not** use the header — the target workspace is identified in the request body (`id` or `slug`) instead.

## Automatic Header Injection (Pre-Request Script)

A collection-level **pre-request script** automatically injects the `X-Workspace-Id` header before every request. When the `workspace_id` collection variable is set (non-empty), the script adds or updates the header via `pm.request.headers.upsert`. If `workspace_id` is empty or missing, the script returns early and no header is injected.

**Skip logic** — the header is NOT injected for the following paths:

- `/health-check` and the root index `/`
- Auth endpoints: `/auth/register`, `/auth/login`, `/auth/reset-password`, `/auth/update-password`, `/auth/confirm`, `/auth/resend-confirm`, and all paths under `/auth/oauth/`
- All workspace endpoints (paths under `/workspace`) — the target workspace is identified in the request body (`id` or `slug`) instead
- `/clients/validate` — authenticated via `client_secret` in the request body

## Filtering List Endpoints

All list endpoints (List Accounts, List Clients, List Workspaces, List Projects, List Roles, List Permissions, List Memberships, List Credentials) accept an optional `filter` object:

- `filter.tags`: `string[]` — entities must carry all listed tags
- `filter.fields`: `object` — exact-match filters on entity fields (e.g. `{"email": "alice@example.com"}`)

`filter.tags` and `filter.fields` **can be combined** — both filters are applied together with AND logic.

For a no-filter query, send an empty body `{}` — the endpoint returns all entities in the current workspace using pagination defaults.

## Auth Flow
| Step | Request | Result |
|------|---------|--------|
| 1 | Auth > Login | Obtains `token` |
| 2 | Auth > Refresh Token | Renews `token` before expiry |
| 3 | Auth > Revoke Token | Invalidates `token` (logout) |

## Auth Variables
| Variable | Source | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| `token` | Manual (copy from Login response) | JWT Bearer token for all authenticated requests |
| `owner_email` | User-provided | Bootstrap account email (default: user@email.com) |
| `owner_password` | User-provided | Bootstrap account password (default: password) |
| `reset_token` | Manual (from email or server log) | Password reset JWT |
| `confirm_token` | Manual (from email or server log) | Account confirmation JWT |
| `oauth_code` | Manual (from browser redirect) | Google OAuth authorization code |
| `oauth_state` | Manual (from Auth Initiate response) | Google OAuth CSRF state |
| `workspace_id` | Manual (from Workspace > Create Workspace) | Target workspace id for entity requests; sent via the `X-Workspace-Id` header when using global-scope tokens |

item.name: Auth
item.description:
Authentication endpoints for local email/password login, Google OAuth2, token management, password reset, and account verification.

Public endpoints (no Bearer token required): Register, Login, Reset Password, Update Password, Confirm Account, Resend Confirm, OAuth Initiate, OAuth Callback.
Protected endpoints (Bearer token required): Refresh Token, Revoke Token.

## Client Variables
| Variable | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| `owner_email` | Test account email (default: user@email.com) |
| `owner_password` | Test account password (default: password) |
| `reset_token` | JWT from password reset email (set manually after testing reset flow) |
| `confirm_token` | JWT from confirmation email (set manually after testing confirm flow) |

request.description:
### Register

Creates a new local account with email and password. Returns a JWT token and the account object.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| email | string | Yes | Unique email address |
| password | string | Yes | Account password (non-empty) |
| name | string | No | Display name |

#### Response

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "data": {
    "access_token": "eyJ...",
    "refresh_token": "eyJ...",
    "account": {
      "id": "uuid",
      "email": "newuser@example.com",
      "name": "New User",
      "verified": false,
      "enabled": true
    }
  }
}
```

#### Possible Errors
- 400: Email already exists
- 400: Missing or empty password
- 400: Invalid email format

### Login

Authenticates with email and password credentials. Returns a JWT token (60-minute TTL) and the account object.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| email | string | Yes | Registered email address |
| password | string | Yes | Account password |

#### Response

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "data": {
    "access_token": "eyJ...",
    "refresh_token": "eyJ...",
    "account": {
      "id": "uuid",
      "email": "user@email.com",
      "name": "...",
      "verified": true,
      "enabled": true
    }
  }
}
```

#### Possible Errors
- 401: Invalid credentials
- 401: Account locked (rate limit — 5 failed attempts triggers 15-min lockout)
- 401: Account disabled
- 400: Attempt to login on OAuth-only account (use Google login or reset password)

### Refresh Token

Exchanges a valid Bearer token for a new JWT with renewed expiry (60 minutes from now). No request body required — the current token in the Authorization header provides identity.

**Auth required:** Bearer token

#### Response

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "data": {
    "access_token": "eyJ...",
    "refresh_token": "eyJ..."
  }
}
```

#### Possible Errors
- 401: Invalid, expired, or revoked token
- 401: Account disabled

### Reset Password (Request)

Requests a password reset email for the given address. Always returns success to prevent email enumeration. The reset token (24h TTL) is logged server-side and included in the email.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| email | string | Yes | The account email address |

#### Response

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "data": {
    "message": "If an account exists for this email, a reset link has been sent."
  }
}
```

#### Note
If the email does not exist in the system, the same success response is returned (anti-enumeration). No email is sent in that case.

### Update Password (with Reset Token)

Sets a new password using a valid password reset token. The token must be of type `PasswordReset` and not expired (24h TTL).

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| token | string | Yes | JWT password reset token |
| password | string | Yes | New password (non-empty) |

#### Response

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "data": {
    "account_id": "uuid..."
  }
}
```

#### Possible Errors
- 400: Invalid or expired token
- 400: Wrong token type (e.g., using a confirmation token)
- 401: Account disabled

### Confirm Account

Verifies a user's email address using a confirmation token generated during registration. The token must be of type `AccountConfirm` and not expired (24h TTL).

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| token | string | Yes | JWT confirmation token from registration email |

#### Response

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "data": {
    "account_id": "uuid...",
    "verified": true
  }
}
```

#### Possible Errors
- 400: Invalid or expired token
- 400: Wrong token type
- 400: Account already verified

### Resend Confirmation Email

Resends the account confirmation email for an unverified account. Silently succeeds if the account doesn't exist (anti-enumeration).

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| email | string | Yes | The account email address |

#### Response

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "data": {
    "message": "If an unverified account exists, a new confirmation email has been sent."
  }
}
```

#### Possible Errors
- 400: Account already verified

### Revoke Token (Logout)

Revokes the current JWT token, rendering it invalid for future requests. The token is blacklisted in Redis with a TTL matching its remaining lifetime and persisted to the database.

**Auth required:** Bearer token (the token being revoked)

#### Response

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "data": {
    "revoked": true
  }
}
```

#### Possible Errors
- 401: Invalid or expired token
- 401: Token already revoked

### OAuth: Initiate Google Login

Starts the Google OAuth2 login flow. Generates a cryptographically random CSRF token, stores it in Redis (10-min TTL), and returns the complete Google authorization URL that the client should redirect the user to.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| redirect_url | string | Yes | Where to redirect the user after OAuth completes (your app's callback page) |

#### Response

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "data": {
    "auth_url": "https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth?client_id=...&redirect_uri=...&response_type=code&scope=openid+email+profile&state=..."
  }
}
```

query.description: CSRF state token from the initiation endpoint

request.description:
### OAuth: Google Callback

Read-only GET endpoint that Google redirects the user to after they complete the consent screen. Processes the authorization code, exchanges it for tokens, fetches the Google user profile, creates or links an account, and redirects the user to the client-provided `redirect_url` with the JWT token as a query parameter.

**This is NOT a JSON endpoint** — it returns a 302 redirect.

#### Query Parameters

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| code | string | Yes | Google OAuth2 authorization code |
| state | string | Yes | CSRF state token (validated against Redis) |

#### Response

```http
HTTP/1.1 302 Found
Location: http://localhost:5000/dashboard?token=eyJ...
```

#### Possible Error Redirects
- `?error=invalid_state` — CSRF mismatch
- `?error=oauth_failed` — Google API error or invalid code

#### Note
This endpoint is meant to be called by the browser (Google redirect), not directly via Postman. Use the OAuth Initiate endpoint to get the `auth_url`, then follow it in a browser.

item.name: Clients
item.description:
Client registration and management for external microservices. Clients are workspace-scoped entities used for token validation and receiving push updates.

Note: Clients are NOT OAuth2/OIDC clients — they are microservice registration entities.

**Auth required:** Bearer token for all endpoints.

header.description: Required for global-scope tokens. Sets the target workspace. Ignored for workspace-scoped tokens.

request.description:
### Create Client

Creates a new client within a workspace. The client secret is returned once — store it securely.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| name | string | Yes | Human-readable name |
| endpoint | string | No | Update endpoint URL for push notifications |
| description | string | No | Optional description |
| tags | string[] | No | Categorization tags |
| meta | object | No | Metadata (requires schema_version) |

#### Response

Returns the created Client object including the `secret` field (only returned once).

!!! warning Store the secret immediately — it cannot be retrieved later.

header.description: Required for global-scope tokens. Sets the target workspace. Ignored for workspace-scoped tokens.

request.description:
### Describe Client

Retrieves a client by ID within a workspace. The secret is never returned.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| id | uuid | Yes | Client ID to describe |

#### Response

Returns the Client object (excluding secret).

header.description: Required for global-scope tokens. Sets the target workspace. Ignored for workspace-scoped tokens.

request.description:
### List Clients

Lists all clients within a workspace with optional filtering and pagination.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| filter | object | No | Filter with tags and fields |
| options | object | No | Pagination with limit, offset, order_bys |

#### Filter Fields
- id: UUID
- name: string
- description: string

#### Response

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "data": {
    "clients": [...],
    "metadata": { ... }
  }
}
```

header.description: Required for global-scope tokens. Sets the target workspace. Ignored for workspace-scoped tokens.

request.description:
### Update Client

Updates client fields. All fields except id are optional.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| id | uuid | Yes | Client ID to update |
| name | string | No | New display name |
| endpoint | string | No | New update endpoint URL |
| description | string | No | New description |
| tags | string[] | No | Replacement tags |
| meta | object | No | New metadata |

#### Response

Returns the updated Client object.

header.description: Required for global-scope tokens. Sets the target workspace. Ignored for workspace-scoped tokens.

request.description:
### Delete Client

Deletes a client by ID. Destructive operation — cannot be undone.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| id | uuid | Yes | Client ID to delete |

#### Response

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "data": {
    "id": "uuid..."
  }
}
```

header.description: Required for global-scope tokens. Sets the target workspace. Ignored for workspace-scoped tokens.

request.description:
### Regenerate Client Secret

Rotates the client secret. Old secret is immediately invalidated. New secret returned in plaintext.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| id | uuid | Yes | Client ID |

#### Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| id | uuid | Client identifier |
| secret | string | New plaintext secret (store immediately) |

!!! warning The old secret stops working immediately.

item.name: Workspace
item.description:
Multi-tenant workspace management. Workspaces are the top-level organizational unit.

**Auth required:** Bearer token for all endpoints.

request.description:
### Create Workspace

Creates a new workspace (tenant). The slug must be globally unique.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| name | string | Yes | Display name of the workspace |
| slug | string | Yes | URL-friendly unique identifier |
| description | string | No | Optional description |
| config | object | Yes | Workspace configuration (must include `schema_version`) |
| tags | string[] | Yes | Tags for categorization |
| meta | object | Yes | Metadata (must include `schema_version`) |

#### Response

Returns the created workspace object with `id`, `name`, `slug`, `created_at`, etc.

### Describe Workspace

Retrieves a workspace by its `id` or `slug`.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| id | uuid | No* | Workspace ID (either id or slug required) |
| slug | string | No* | Workspace slug (either id or slug required) |

#### Response

Returns the full workspace object with all fields.

### List Workspaces

Lists all workspaces with optional filtering and pagination.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| filter | object | No | Filter params with `tags` (string[]) and `fields` (object with field filters) |
| options | object | No | Pagination: `limit` (int), `offset` (int), `order_bys` (string, e.g. "!created_at" for DESC) |

#### Filter Fields
- `id`: UUID filter
- `name`: string filter
- `slug`: string filter
- `description`: string filter

#### Response

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "data": {
    "workspaces": [...],
    "metadata": {
      "total": 42,
      "count": 10,
      "offset": 0,
      "limit": 10,
      "order_bys": ["!created_at"]
    }
  }
}
```

### Update Workspace

Updates workspace fields. All fields are optional — only include what you want to change.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| id | uuid | No* | Workspace ID (either id or slug required) |
| slug | string | No* | Workspace slug to identify (either id or slug required) |
| name | string | No | New display name |
| description | string | No | New description |
| config | object | No | New config |
| tags | string[] | No | New tags |
| meta | object | No | New metadata |

#### Response

Returns the updated workspace object.

### Delete Workspace

Deletes a workspace by `id` or `slug`. This is a destructive operation.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| id | uuid | No* | Workspace ID (either id or slug required) |
| slug | string | No* | Workspace slug (either id or slug required) |

#### Response

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "data": {
    "id": "uuid...",
    "slug": "my-org",
    "name": "My Organization"
  }
}
```

item.name: Accounts
item.description:
User account management. Accounts are global identities that can belong to multiple workspaces via memberships.

**Auth required:** Bearer token for all endpoints.

header.description: Required for global-scope tokens. Sets the target workspace. Ignored for workspace-scoped tokens.

request.description:
### Create Account

Creates a new user account within a workspace. The email must be unique.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| email | string | Yes | Unique email address |
| password | string | Yes | Account password (hashed with Argon2) |
| name | string | Yes | Display name |
| description | string | No | Optional description |
| avatar_url | string | No | Avatar image URL |
| tags | string[] | No | Tags for categorization |
| meta | object | No | Metadata (must include `schema_version`) |

#### Response

Returns the created account object.

header.description: Required for global-scope tokens. Sets the target workspace. Ignored for workspace-scoped tokens.

request.description:
### Describe Account

Retrieves an account by `id` or `email`.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| id | uuid | No* | Account ID (either id or email required) |
| email | string | No* | Account email (either id or email required) |

#### Response

Returns the full account object with `id`, `email`, `name`, `enabled`, `verified`, `created_at`, etc.

header.description: Required for global-scope tokens. Sets the target workspace. Ignored for workspace-scoped tokens.

request.description:
### List Accounts

Lists accounts in a workspace with optional filtering and pagination.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| filter | object | No | Filter with `tags` and `fields` |
| options | object | No | Pagination with `limit`, `offset`, `order_bys` |

#### Filter Fields (within `fields`)
- `id`: UUID
- `email`: string
- `name`: string
- `description`: string
- `avatar_url`: string
- `verified`: bool
- `enabled`: bool
- `created_by`: UUID
- `created_at`: datetime
- `updated_by`: UUID
- `updated_at`: datetime

#### Response

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "data": {
    "accounts": [...],
    "metadata": { "total": 15, "count": 10, "offset": 0, "limit": 10, "order_bys": ["!created_at"] }
  }
}
```

header.description: Required for global-scope tokens. Sets the target workspace. Ignored for workspace-scoped tokens.

request.description:
### Update Account

Updates account fields. All fields except the account identifier are optional.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| id | uuid | No* | Account ID (either id or email required) |
| email | string | No* | Account email to identify (when not using id) |
| name | string | No | New display name |
| description | string | No | New description |
| avatar_url | string | No | New avatar URL |
| enabled | bool | No | Enable/disable account |
| verified | bool | No | Verify/unverify account |
| tags | string[] | No | New tags |
| meta | object | No | New metadata |

#### Response

Returns the updated account object.

header.description: Required for global-scope tokens. Sets the target workspace. Ignored for workspace-scoped tokens.

request.description:
### Delete Account

Deletes an account by `id` or `email`.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| id | uuid | No* | Account ID (either id or email required) |
| email | string | No* | Account email (either id or email required) |

#### Response

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "data": {
    "id": "uuid..."
  }
}
```

item.name: Projects
item.description:
Project management within workspaces. Projects represent scoped work areas or applications.

**Auth required:** Bearer token for all endpoints.

header.description: Required for global-scope tokens. Sets the target workspace. Ignored for workspace-scoped tokens.

request.description:
### Create Project

Creates a new project within a workspace. The name must be unique within the workspace.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| name | string | Yes | Project name (unique per workspace) |
| code | string | No | Short code identifier |
| description | string | No | Optional description |
| config | object | Yes | Project configuration |
| tags | string[] | Yes | Tags for categorization |
| meta | object | Yes | Metadata |

#### Response

Returns the created project object.

header.description: Required for global-scope tokens. Sets the target workspace. Ignored for workspace-scoped tokens.

request.description:
### Describe Project

Retrieves a project by `id` or `code` within a workspace.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| id | uuid | No* | Project ID (either id or code required) |
| code | string | No* | Project code (either id or code required) |

#### Response

Returns the full project object.

header.description: Required for global-scope tokens. Sets the target workspace. Ignored for workspace-scoped tokens.

request.description:
### List Projects

Lists projects within a workspace with optional filtering and pagination.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| filter | object | No | Filter with `tags` and `fields` |
| options | object | No | Pagination with `limit`, `offset`, `order_bys` |

#### Filter Fields
- `id`: UUID
- `workspace_id`: UUID
- `name`: string
- `code`: string
- `description`: string

#### Response

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "data": {
    "projects": [...],
    "metadata": { ... }
  }
}
```

header.description: Required for global-scope tokens. Sets the target workspace. Ignored for workspace-scoped tokens.

request.description:
### Update Project

Updates project fields. All fields except the project identifier are optional.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| id | uuid | No* | Project ID (either id or code required) |
| code | string | No* | Current project code to identify (when not using id) |
| name | string | No | New name |
| new_code | string | No | New code (to rename) |
| description | string | No | New description |
| config | object | No | New config |
| tags | string[] | No | New tags |
| meta | object | No | New metadata |

#### Response

Returns the updated project object.

header.description: Required for global-scope tokens. Sets the target workspace. Ignored for workspace-scoped tokens.

request.description:
### Delete Project

Deletes a project by `id` or `code`.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| id | uuid | No* | Project ID (either id or code required) |
| code | string | No* | Project code (either id or code required) |

#### Response

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "data": {
    "id": "uuid...",
    "code": "web-app",
    "name": "Web Application"
  }
}
```

item.name: Roles
item.description:
Role-based access control (RBAC). Roles bundle permissions together.

**Auth required:** Bearer token for all endpoints.

header.description: Required for global-scope tokens. Sets the target workspace. Ignored for workspace-scoped tokens.

request.description:
### Create Role

Creates a new role with associated permissions. The name must be unique within the workspace.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| name | string | Yes | Role name (unique per workspace) |
| description | string | No | Optional description |
| permission_ids | uuid[] | Yes | Permissions to attach to this role |
| tags | string[] | Yes | Tags |
| meta | object | Yes | Metadata |

#### Response

Returns the created role object with nested permissions.

header.description: Required for global-scope tokens. Sets the target workspace. Ignored for workspace-scoped tokens.

request.description:
### Describe Role

Retrieves a role by its ID.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| id | uuid | Yes | The role ID |

#### Response

Returns the role object with nested permissions.

item.name: Permissions
item.description:
Fine-grained permission management. Permissions use `resource:action` format with wildcard support.

**Auth required:** Bearer token for all endpoints.

header.description: Required for global-scope tokens. Sets the target workspace. Ignored for workspace-scoped tokens.

request.description:
### Create Permission

Creates a new permission in a workspace. The name must be unique within the workspace.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| name | string | Yes | Permission name (unique per workspace, e.g. "account:read") |
| code | string | No | Machine-readable code |
| description | string | No | Human-readable description |
| tags | string[] | Yes | Tags |
| meta | object | Yes | Metadata |

#### Permission Naming Convention
Permissions use `resource:action` format with wildcard support:
- `*` — all permissions
- `account:*` — all account actions
- `*:read` — read on any resource

#### Response

Returns the created permission object.

item.name: Profiles
item.description:
Workspace-facing profile management. Profiles are the workspace-scoped identity for a person, distinct from the system-wide Account. Each person has exactly one profile per workspace, and memberships reference profiles to grant access. The profile `email` is unique within a workspace (case-insensitive).

**Auth required:** Bearer token for all endpoints.

header.description: Required for global-scope tokens. Sets the target workspace. Ignored for workspace-scoped tokens.

request.description:
### Describe Profile

Retrieves a profile by `id` or `email` within the caller's workspace. Exactly one of `id` or `email` is required; when both are supplied, `id` takes precedence.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| id | uuid | No* | Profile ID (either id or email required) |
| email | string | No* | Workspace-facing profile email (either id or email required) |

#### Response

Returns the full `Profile` object with workspace-facing persona data and `email`; account-level identity is never exposed.

header.description: Required for global-scope tokens. Sets the target workspace. Ignored for workspace-scoped tokens.

request.description:
### List Profiles

Lists profiles within a workspace with optional filtering and pagination. The filter supports `email` for case-insensitive matching.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| filter | object | No | Profile filters (null for no filter) |
| options | object | No | Pagination with `limit` and `offset` |

#### Response

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "data": {
    "profiles": [...],
    "metadata": { "count": 1, "limit": 50, "offset": 0 }
  }
}
```

header.description: Required for global-scope tokens. Sets the target workspace. Ignored for workspace-scoped tokens.

request.description:
### Update Profile

Updates profile fields. All fields except `id` are optional (patch semantics); `name` must be non-empty when supplied. `email` must remain unique within the workspace (case-insensitive).

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| id | uuid | Yes | Profile ID |
| email | string | No | Workspace-facing contact email |
| name | string | No | Persona name (non-empty when supplied) |
| description | string | No | Optional description |
| display_name | string | No | Display name |
| job_title | string | No | Job title |
| timezone | string | No | IANA timezone |
| avatar_url | string | No | Avatar image URL |
| tags | string[] | No | Replacement tags |
| meta | object | No | New metadata |

#### Response

Returns the updated `Profile` object.

item.name: Policies
item.description:
AWS-IAM-style authorization policies. Each rule declares an `effect` (allow/deny), a `principal`, a set of `actions`, a `resource`, and an optional `constraint`. Policies are attached to roles and memberships and constrain what those grants may actually do. Policy CRUD is workspace-admin only.

**Auth required:** Bearer token for all endpoints.

header.description: Required for global-scope tokens. Sets the target workspace. Ignored for workspace-scoped tokens.

request.description:
### Describe Policy

Retrieves a policy by ID within the caller's workspace.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| id | uuid | Yes | Policy ID |

#### Response

Returns the full `Policy` object.

header.description: Required for global-scope tokens. Sets the target workspace. Ignored for workspace-scoped tokens.

body.raw:
{
    "name": "self-update",
    "effect": "allow",
    "principal_id": null,
    "actions": [
        "profile:update",
        "membership:update"
    ],
    "resource": "self",
    "constraint": "profile.account.id === user.id",
    "description": "Members may update their own profile/membership",
    "tags": [],
    "meta": {}
}

request.description:
### Create Policy

Creates a policy within the caller's workspace. Policy creation is workspace-admin only.

#### Request Body

The request body is the full policy document. Only `effect`, `actions`, and `resource` are required.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| name | string | No | Unique per workspace when present |
| effect | string | Yes | "allow" or "deny" |
| principal_id | uuid | No | Defaults to the attachment target |
| actions | string[] | Yes | "resource:action" pairs; "*" allowed |
| resource | string | Yes | "self", "<uuid>", or "*" |
| constraint | string | No | Constraint DSL expression |
| description | string | No | Free-form description |
| tags | string[] | No | Categorization tags |
| meta | object | No | Extensible metadata |

#### Response

Returns the created `Policy` object.

item.name: Validate
item.description:
Service-to-service token validation endpoint. Authenticates via client_secret in the request body (NOT Bearer token). Used by registered client microservices to validate end-user tokens.

**Auth:** Client secret in request body — no Bearer token required.

request.description:
### Validate Token

Validates a user\'s access token against required permissions. Authenticated by client_secret instead of Bearer token.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| client_secret | string | Yes | Client\'s plaintext secret (authenticates the client and resolves workspace) |
| user_token | string | Yes | End user\'s JWT Bearer token to validate |
| required_permissions | string[] | Yes | Permissions the user must possess |

#### Success Response (Authorized)

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "data": { "authorized": true }
}
```

#### Denial Response (Not Authorized)

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "data": { "authorized": false }
}
```

Note: Always returns HTTP 200 — authorization failures return authorized: false, not 4xx errors (anti-enumeration).
